questions.question: What's the 'breaking point' that pushes a growing team off spreadsheets?
questions.answer_summary: monday.com's blog frames it directly: 'Every growing team hits a breaking point where spreadsheets and email threads stop working,' used as the premise for multiple of their tool-comparison articles.

questions.question: What specifically goes wrong with spreadsheet-based sales tracking?
questions.answer_summary: monday.com's content targets teams struggling with scattered sales data and manual tracking typical of spreadsheet-based pipelines.

questions.question: Why do recruiting/CRM processes break down in spreadsheets?
questions.answer_summary: monday.com notes conversation history 'disappears across scattered tools' when hiring pipelines are tracked in disconnected sheets and inboxes.

questions.question: Does switching to dedicated invoicing tools actually help solopreneurs scale?
questions.answer_summary: FreshBooks features a customer case study of a solopreneur (Jules Webb) building a six-figure business, used to illustrate growth enabled by moving off manual/spreadsheet workflows into dedicated tools.

questions.question: What accounting basics matter once a business moves past ad hoc spreadsheet tracking?
questions.answer_summary: FreshBooks covers foundational concepts like the difference between revenue and profit as prerequisites for using a proper accounting system instead of DIY sheets.
